scope: Manual CardReward constructor lifecycle and Options/RerollOptions split; source-derived, not installed-game evidence

facts.manual_constructor: Initial Options include IsCardReward; RerollOptions are preserved unchanged; does not subscribe RelicObtained
facts.regular_constructor: Both Options and RerollOptions add IsCardReward and constructor subscribes RelicObtained
facts.Populate: Manual initial list still runs Hook.TryModifyCardRewardOptions; reroll populates from RerollOptions
facts.Hook.TryModifyCardRewardOptions: Includes both regular and late callback passes
facts.OnRelicObtained: Regular subscribed reward invokes hooks with initial Options even after a reroll
